prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. Animals in pairs, two camels, two oxen, two deer, stand in a calm line on a plain earthen ramp leading up to the wide wooden door open in the side of a giant long rectangular wooden crate of rough planks smeared pitch-black, with a flat plank roof and flat square ends, as tall at both ends as in the middle, the roof empty and flat, onlookers in silhouette on a ridge seen from behind, faces turned away toward the crate, in the foreground. Morning, soft grey light and dust. Strange and orderly. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
